name: The Riverbank
guide:
Waypoint: No Boss: The Bloated Miller Quests: Reaching Clearfell ( Uncut Skill Gem Level 1)
The Riverbank is where the game begins. Select a movement type, walk forward and speak to the wounded man. Defeat the Zombie to loot your starting weapon, then equip it before progressing forward.
Toward the middle of the zone, you find a Large Chest containing your first Skill Gem.
Follow the tutorial prompts:
To socket your Skill Gem into the Skill Gem Panel (Default Hotkey: G) Left Click the Skill Icon & Place it on your Skill Bar Continue travelling forward until you find The Bloated Miller.
Defeat the The Bloated Miller , collect your loot, and head to The Clearfell Encampment .
guide_zh_tw:
傳送點: 無頭目: 浮腫米勒任務: 抵達皆伐（未切割的技能寶石等級 1）
遊戲就從河岸開始。選擇移動類型，向前走並與受傷的人說話。打敗殭屍以掠奪起始武器，然後裝備好再繼續前進。
在區域中間，會發現一個大箱子，裡面有第一個技能寶石。
按照教學提示來做：
將您的技能寶石插入技能寶石面板（預設熱鍵：G）左鍵按一下技能圖示，並將其放置在您的技能欄上繼續前進，直到找到浮腫米勒。
打敗浮腫米勒，收集戰利品，然後前往皆伐營地。

name: Clearfell Encampment
guide:
NPCs: Renly ; Una ; Finn
The Clearfell Encampment is the first town in Path of Exile 2.
Towns are safe zones and serve as a central hub, featuring:
A Waypoint Your Stashes A Healing Well & NPCs
NPCs act as vendors, progress various questlines, or offer quest rewards.
The Clearfell Encampment has 3 NPCs by default:
Renly : Sells Weapons, Body Armours, Helms, Gloves, Bloots, Shields, Quivers & Belts. Una : Sells Sceptres, ES Shields, Wands, Staves, Life Flasks, Mana Flasks, Wisdom Scrolls, Rings, Amulets & Charms. Una can also Disenchant Magic Items & Rare Items for Transmutation or Regal Shards. Finn : allows you to Gamble Gold for Items of an unknown rarity.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 倫利 ; 烏娜 ; 費恩
皆伐營地是第一座城鎮。城鎮是安全區，也是中心樞紐，具有以下特色：一個傳送點，倉庫頁，治療井與 NPC
NPC 充當賣家、推進各種任務線路或提供任務獎勵。
皆伐營地預設有 3 位 NPC：
倫利 : 售賣武器、護甲、頭盔、手套、盾牌、箭筒和腰帶。烏娜 : 賣權杖、ES 盾牌、法杖、長杖、生命藥劑、魔力藥劑、智慧卷軸、戒指、護身符和護符。也可以對魔法物品和稀有物品進行祛魔，以獲得蛻變石碎片或富豪石碎片。費恩 : 允許您用黃金賭未知稀有度的物品。
關於 NPC 的聲明: 僅列出每個城鎮預設可找到的 NPC。臨時聯盟可能會增加您可以與之互動的其他 NPC，作為該聯盟獨特機制的一部分。

name: Clearfell
content: Beira of the Rotten Pack ( +10 % to Cold Resistance 1 Broken Boss Faces )
content_zh_tw: 腐敗獸群．貝伊拉 ( +10 % 冰冷抗性 1 打爛頭目的臉 )
guide:
Bosses: Beira of the Rotten Pack ( Head of the Winter Wolf : Grants +10% to Cold Resistance) Quests: None
Clearfell is the second monster-inhabited zone and contains no immediate quest objectives.
In the centre of the zone, players can find Beira of the Rotten Pack ; an ice themed unique boss. Defeating Beira will provide the Head of the Winter Wolf , a permanent consumable buff granting +10% to Cold Resistance. It is possible to immediately defeat Beira, as a Level 2 character; but can also be completed later.
On the right side of the Zone, players can find the entrance to the Mud Burrow along with a Waypoint. Near the top right, players can find the exit to The Grelwood. Opposite the Mud Burrow, on the other side of the Zone, players can find an Abandoned Stash that drops an Uncut Skill Gem Level 1.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 腐敗獸群．貝伊拉 ( 凜冬狼的頭顱 : 賦予 +10% 冰冷抗性)
皆伐是第二個怪物居住的區域，沒有直接的任務目標。
在這個區域的中央，玩家可以找到以冰為主題的獨特頭目「腐敗獸群．貝伊拉」。打敗貝伊拉會獲得「凜冬狼的頭顱」，這是一個永久消耗的增益，可賦予 +10% 冰冷抗性。
在區域的右邊，玩家可以找到泥沼陋居的入口，以及一個傳送點。在右上方附近，可以找到葛瑞爾林的出口。在泥濘洞穴的對面，區域的另一側，玩家可找到一個廢棄儲物箱，該處會掉落一顆未切割的技能寶石等級 1。

name: Mud Burrow
guide:
Waypoint: No Bosses: The Devourer (Optional) Quests: Treacherous Ground ( Uncut Support Gem Level 1, Gold)
The Mud Burrow is a narrow winding zone with an optional quest to Defeat the Devourer. The Devourer is a physical and chaos themed boss. The Devourer's abilities are telegraphed and can be avoided with careful positioning and movement. The Devourer’s chaos projectile barrage in particular can be avoided with Dodge Roll invincibility frames.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 吞噬獸 (可選) 任務: 險惡之地 ( 未切割的輔助寶石等級1)
吞噬獸是一個狹窄蜿蜒的區域，其中有一個打敗吞噬獸的任選任務。吞噬獸是一個以物理和混沌為主題的頭目。吞噬獸的能力是穿透地面，只要小心走位和移動就能避開。尤其是吞噬獸的混沌射彈砲彈，可以利用閃避無敵來躲避。

name: The Grelwood
guide:
Bosses: The Brambleghast (Optional), Areagne, Forgotten Witch (Optional) Quests: Secrets in the Dark Points of Interest: Tree of Souls, The Red Vale
The Grelwood is an open forested area and is host to a multiple zone questline.
Search the Grelwood for the Tree of Souls and progressing to The Red Vale .
Areagne, Forgotten Witch : an optional miniboss that can be difficult to defeat on a low level character, due to her frequent use of teleportation, cold degens and curses. Defeating Areagne for the first time rewards an Uncut Support Gem Level 1. Located inside her hut is a Cauldron, which drops a Medium Life & Mana Flask. Note: you can open the Cauldron without defeating Areagne.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 荊棘懼怪 (可選), 忘卻女巫．阿瑞涅 (可選) 任務: 黑暗中的秘密興趣點: 攝魂之樹
葛瑞爾林是一個開放的森林區域，並擁有多個區域的任務線。
搜尋攝魂之樹，再沿著河流上游前往赤谷。
忘卻女巫．阿瑞涅 : 是一個可選的迷你頭目，由於她經常使用傳送、寒冷持續傷害和詛咒，因此對於低階角色來說很難擊敗她。第一次打敗阿瑞涅會獲得 1 級輔助寶石。在她的小屋裡有一個大鍋，會掉落一個中型生命藥劑 & 中型魔力藥劑。注意：您可以在不打敗阿瑞涅的情況下打開熔爐。荊棘懼怪 : 未切割的技能寶石等級2。

name: The Red Vale
guide:
Bosses: The Rust King Quests: Secrets in the Dark Points of Interest: 3 Obelisks of Rust
The Red Vale is an open zone and contains 3 Obelisks of Rust. When interacting with an Obelisk of Rust, a wave of monsters spawn that need to be defeated to acquire 3 Runed Girdle quest items.
Upon interacting with the third and final Obelisk of Rust, The Rust King spawns instead of a wave of monsters. Defeating the Rust King drops the last Runed Girdle .
After acquiring all three Runed Girdles, head to town and speak to Renly, to acquire the Runed Spikes quest item. Afterward, return to the Old Forest and search for the Tree of Souls.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 鐵鏽之王任務: 黑暗中的秘密興趣點: 3 個鐵鏽方尖碑
赤谷是一個開放區域，裡面有 3 個鐵鏽方尖碑。與鐵鏽方尖碑互動時，會產生一波怪獸，必須打敗這些怪獸才能獲得 3 件符文護帶任務物品。
與第三座也是最後一座鐵鏽方尖碑互動時，會出現鐵鏽之王，而不是怪物。打敗鏽蝕國王會掉落最後一個符文護帶。
取得所有三個符文護帶後，前往鎮上與倫利對話，取得符文尖刺任務物品。之後回到葛瑞爾林尋找靈魂之樹。

name: The Grim Tangle
guide:
Bosses: The Rotten Druid (Optional) Quests: The Mysterious Shade
The Grim Tangle is another narrow winding zone and contains no immediate quest objectives. Players should navigate through the zone, in search of the Cemetery of the Eternals.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 腐敗的德魯伊 (可選) 任務: 神祕的影魅
纏縛陰林是另一個狹窄蜿蜒的區域，沒有直接的任務目標。玩家應該穿過這個區域，尋找「不朽帝國之墓」。
符文探求者符文陣

name: Cemetery of the Eternals
guide:
NPCs: Lachlann the Lost Quests: Sorrow Among Stones Points of Interest: Tomb of the Consort , Mausoleum of the Praetor
The Cemetery of the Eternals is an open area and is host to another multiple zone questline. Players need to search for the Tomb of the Tomb of Consort & the Mausoleum of the Praetor , defeating the bosses inside, before returning to the Cemetery of the Eternals and speaking to Lachlann the Lost .
Author's Note: There is no meaningful difference in which zone you complete first. Completing the zones in the order you find them is recommended!
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 迷失者．拉克朗任務: 石頭上的悲傷興趣點: 配偶的墓室 , 政務官陵墓
不朽帝國之墓是一個開放的區域，也是另一個多區域任務線的所在地。玩家需要尋找配偶的墓室 & 政務官陵墓，擊敗裡面的頭目後，再回到不朽帝國之墓和迷失者．拉克朗對話。
作者註：先完成哪個區域並無意義。建議依序完成區域！

name: Mausoleum of the Praetor
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 永恆政務官．德雷文任務: 石頭上的悲傷
政務官陵墓是另一個地下區域，也是永恆政務官．德雷文的家。
尋找並擊敗永恆政務官．德雷文，即可獲得德雷文的回憶之鑰碎片。

name: Tomb of the Consort
guide:
Bosses: Asinia, the Praetor's Consort Quests: Sorrow Among Stones
The Tomb of the Consort is another underground zone and is home to Asinia, the Praetor's Consort .
Search for and defeat Asinia, to acquire Asinia's Memorial Key Piece .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 政務官配偶．阿席妮雅任務: 石頭上的悲傷
配偶的墓室是另一個地下區域，也是政務官配偶．阿席妮雅的家。
尋找並擊敗政務官配偶．阿席妮雅，取得阿席妮雅的回憶之鑰碎片。

name: Hunting Grounds
content: The Crowbell ( 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points )
content_zh_tw: 鴉鈴 ( 2 武器套裝天賦點 )
guide:
Bosses: The Crowbell (Optional) (2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points) Quests: None Points of Interest: Freythorn , Ogham Farmlands
The Hunting Grounds is an open zone inhabited by extremely dangerous monsters, extra care is required to progress forward safely. The Crowbell is an optional boss that provides 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points if defeated.
Connected to the Hunting Grounds are the Freythorn and the Ogham Farmlands . It is recommended to find the Freythorn first before progressing forward, as the optional boss inside will provide +30 Spirit and a Persistent Skill Gem.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 鴉鈴 (可選) (2 天賦點) 興趣點: 弗雷索恩 , 奧格姆農地
獵場是一個開放區域，居住著極其危險的怪物，需要格外小心才能安全前進。
鴉鈴是一個可選的頭目，打敗後會提供 2 個天賦點。遇到祭祀事件，掉落未切割的技能寶石等級4，結束烏鴉會指向弗雷索恩。遇到束縛事件，掉落未切割的輔助寶石等級1。德爾溫在此研究魂靈，跟著魂靈到稀有怪物完成任務。
連接到狩獵場的是弗雷索恩和奧格姆農地。建議先找到弗雷索恩再繼續前進，因為裡面的可選頭目會提供 +30 精魂值和精魂寶石。
符文探求者符文陣

name: Freythorn
content: The King in the Mists ( +30 to Spirit 1 Broken Boss Faces )
content_zh_tw: 迷霧之王 ( +30 精魂 1 打爛頭目的臉 )
guide:
Bosses: The King in the Mists ( Gembloom Skull : +30 Spirit, Uncut Spirit Gem Level 4: Creates a Persistent Buff Skill Gem at Level 4) Quests: Ominous Altars (Optional) (A Normal Rarity Ruby Charm , Sapphire Charm or Topaz Charm ) Points of Interest: 3 Ritual Altars
Freythorn is hoisted above the Hunting Grounds, it is composed of narrow wooden walkways and filled with dangerous ritual enemies. This is home to the King in the Mists.
Search for the three Ritual Altars, interact with them, and defeat the newly spawned enemies to cleanse the Ritual.
After cleansing three Ritual Altars, head to the top of the zone, in search of a much larger Ritual Altar. Clear the enemies surrounding it and interact with the larger Ritual Altar to begin the final Ritual, spawning another wave of monsters. Defeat the monsters and The King in the Mists spawns.
The King in the Mists is a multi-phase, physical, and chaos themed boss, with both ranged and melee abilities. During the fight, the King in the Mists will cast either a purple or red debuff on you.
If the debuff is purple: keep moving to avoid being frozen.
If the debuff is red: stand still to avoid being frozen. Standing still can be dangerous, so either maintain distance before the red debuff is cast, or, build up the boss's stagger bar and stun them when afflicted by the red debuff.
After defeating the King in the Mists. Loot the Gembloom Skull and consume it for a +30 Spirit buff. Consuming the Gembloom Skull will also create an Uncut Spirit Gem Level 4, allowing you to create your first Persistent Buff Skill Gem. Head to town and speak to Finn, who will offer you a normal rarity Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz Charm. Select one and progress further.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 迷霧之王 ( 寶石花顱骨 : +30 精魂, 精魂寶石等級 4: 創造第一個持久增益技能寶石) 任務: 不祥祭壇 (可選) (普通稀有度紅玉護符 , 藍玉護符或黃玉護符 ) 興趣點: 3 祭祀祭壇
弗雷索恩被吊在狩獵場的上方，它由狹窄的木制走道組成，充滿了危險的儀式敵人。這裡是迷霧之王的家。
尋找三個儀式祭壇，與它們互動，並擊敗新產生的敵人來淨化儀式。
清理完三個儀式祭壇後，前往區域的頂端，尋找一個更大的儀式祭壇。清除它周圍的敵人，並與較大的儀式祭壇互動，開始最後的儀式，產生另一波怪物。打敗這些怪物後就會出現「迷霧之王」。
迷霧之王是一個多階段、物理和混沌主題的頭目，同時具有射程和近戰能力。在戰鬥中，迷霧之王會對您施放紫色或紅色的減益。
如果是紫色的減益：保持移動以避免被凍結。
如果是紅色的減益：站著不動以避免被凍結。站在原地會很危險，所以在紅色減益施放前保持距離，或者，在受到紅色減益時建立起頭目的眩暈條並擊暈他們。
擊敗「迷霧之王」後。搶奪寶石花顱骨並消耗它以獲得 +30 精魂。消耗寶石花顱骨還會創造一個未切割的 4 級精魂寶石，可以創造第一個持久增益技能寶石。前往城鎮並與費恩交談，他會提供普通稀有度紅玉護符 , 藍玉護符或黃玉護符。選擇其中一個，繼續前進。

name: Ogham Farmlands
content: Una's Hut ( 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points )
content_zh_tw: 烏娜的小屋 ( 2 武器套裝天賦點 )
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: The Lost Lute (Optional) (2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points)
Ogham Farmlands is an open zone with an optional quest: The Lost Lute. To complete the Lost Lute: search for a hut containing Una’s Lute, Loot Una’s Lute, and speak to Una in Town to acquire 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points.
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 遺失的魯特琴 (可選) (2 天賦點)
奧格姆農地是一個開放區域，有一個可選擇的任務：遺失的魯特琴，搜尋烏娜魯特琴的小屋，掠奪烏娜的魯特琴，並在城鎮中與烏娜對話，以獲得 2 點天賦點。
麥田圈農地圓形圈會出稀有狼，掉落未切割的技能寶石等級4。符文探求者符文陣

name: Ogham Village
guide:
Bosses: The Executioner Quests: The Trail of Corruption ( Uncut Skill Gem Level 5), Finding the Forge (Optional) (Unlocks the Salvage Bench)
Ogham Village is a fiery village and contains the Executioner, a required boss to progress forward; and an optional but recommended quest, Finding the Forge which unlocks the Salvage Bench.
To complete Finding the Forge: search for Renly’s Smithing Tools and bring them back to Renly in town.
To complete The Trail of Corruption , search for and defeat The Executioner . The Executioner is a physical and fire themed boss, with extremely lethal slam abilities. Pay careful attention to the Executioner's animations to either walk out of or Dodge Roll away from his abilities.
After defeating the Executioner, free the prisoner at the top of the platform, travel forward to the Courtyard, and take the Waypoint to town to speak to Leitis for an Uncut Skill Gem Level 5.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 劊子手任務: 腐化痕跡 ( 未切割的技能寶石等級 5), 尋找熔爐 (可選) (解鎖回收台)
奧格姆村是個火熱的村莊，村莊裡有劊子手，他是前進路上的必經頭目；還有一個可選但建議完成的任務「尋找熔爐」和空白符文，這個任務會解鎖「回收台」。
要完成「尋找熔爐」：尋找倫利的鍛造工具，並將它們帶回鎮上給倫利。
要完成腐敗之徑，尋找並擊敗「劊子手」。劊子手是一個以物理和火焰為主題的頭目，擁有非常致命的猛擊能力。請小心留意劊子手的動畫，以走位或閃避滾動躲避他的能力。
擊敗劊子手後，釋放平台頂端的囚犯，前進到宅第壁壘，然後走傳送點回鎮上與蕾堤絲對話，以獲得 5 級技能寶石。

name: The Manor Ramparts
guide:
Quests: None Bosses: None
The Manor Ramparts is an open zone with no quests or bosses. Progress forward and search for the Oghman Manor.
guide_zh_tw:
宅第壁壘是一個沒有任務或頭目的開放區域。前進並尋找奧格姆宅第。
刑場可以獲得未切割的輔助寶石等級1。

name: Ogham Manor
content: Candlemass, the Living Rite ( +20 to maximum Life 1 Broken Boss Faces )
content_zh_tw: 存活儀式．燭光 ( +20 最大生命 1 打爛頭目的臉 )
guide:
Bosses: Count Geonor (Unlock Act 2), Candlemass, the Living Rite (Candlemass’ Essence: Grants +20 to Maximum Life) Quests: The Mad Wolf of Ogham
The Ogham Manor is a multi-floor indoor zone that contains Count Geonor, a required boss to progress forward; and an optional but recommended boss, Candlemass, that grants a +20 to Maximum Life buff.
Candlemass, the Living Rite is located on the first floor and is a fire themed boss, with both ranged and melee attacks.
Count Geonor , is found on the final floor and is a multi-phase, physical and cold themed boss.
During the first phase, Count Geonor fights you in both human and wolf form. Upon lowering Count Geonor to below half health, he permanently transitions to wolf form and disappears into an arena-wide fog.
During the fog phase normal monsters spawn to provide flask charges. As the fog phase progresses, Count Geonor speaks various voice lines; and at the end of each voice line lunges at you from the fog.
After the fog dissipates, Count Geonor returns in wolf form, with extra abilities. Carefully watch his animations and pay attention to arena-wide AoE abilities.
After defeating Count Geonor, return to town and speak to the Hooded One, selecting the “Follow the Beast’s trail” dialogue option to progress to Act 2 .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 吉恩諾伯爵 (解鎖第 2 章), 存活儀式．燭光 ( 燭光精髓 : 賦予 +20 最大生命) 任務: 奧格姆的狂狼
奧格姆宅第是一個多層樓的室內區域，裡面有一個必要的頭目吉恩諾伯爵，以及一個可選但推薦的頭目存活儀式．燭光，存活儀式．燭光會賦予 +20 最大生命的增益。
存活儀式．燭光位於第一層，是一個以火焰為主題的頭目，可同時使用連續攻擊和近身攻擊。
吉恩諾伯爵位於最後一層，是一個以物理和寒冷為主題的多階段頭目。
在第一階段，吉恩諾伯爵會以人形和狼形與您對戰。當吉恩諾伯爵的生命值降至一半以下時，他會永久轉換成狼形，並消失在全場的霧中。
在霧中階段，會有普通怪物出現，提供水瓶充能。隨著霧氣的進展，吉恩諾伯爵會說出不同的語句，並在每句語句結束時從霧氣中向您撲來。
霧氣消散後，吉恩諾伯爵會以狼的形態回來，並擁有額外的能力。小心觀察他的動畫，並注意全場的 AoE 能力。
擊敗吉恩諾伯爵後，回到鎮上與黑衣幽魂對話，選擇「跟隨種子的踪跡」對話選項進入第二章。
符文探求者到攝魂之樹進入遺忘墓穴的符文寶庫，取回物品回城鎮，出現工藝台：維里西姆鐵砧。

name: The Ardura Caravan
guide:
NPCs: The Hooded One ; Shambrin ; Zarka ; Sekhema Asala
The Ardura Caravan is the second town in Act 2.
Speak to The Hooded One and Sekhema Asala to unlock the Desert Map. Interact with the Desert Map and travel to the Mawdun Quarry, to investigate the Trail of Corruption.
Note: Quest Locations have a Golden Chisel above the zone icon to help locate the next area to travel to.
The Ardura Caravan has 4 NPCs by default and 1 unlockable NPC as the quests progress:
The Hooded One : Identifies items for free and Refunds Passive Points for Gold. Shambrin : Sells Weapons, Body Armours, Helms, Gloves, Bloots, Shields, Quivers & Belts. Zarka : Sells Sceptres, ES Shields, Wands, Staves, Life Flasks, Mana Flasks, Wisdom Scrolls, Rings, Amulets & Charms. Zarka can also Disenchant Magic Items & Rare Items for Transmutation or Regal Shards. Sekhema Asala : is frequently spoken to progress various quests. Risu : allows you to Gamble Gold for Items of an unknown rarity. She does not initially appear by default and is unlocked after defeating Rudja, the Dread Engineer.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 黑衣幽魂 ; 夏布林 ; 札卡 ; 絲克瑪．阿薩拉
阿杜拉車隊是第 2 幕的第 2 個城鎮。
與黑衣幽魂和絲克瑪．阿薩拉對話，解鎖沙漠地圖。與沙漠地圖互動後前往莫頓挖石場，調查腐敗的痕跡。
注意：任務地點的區域圖示上方有一個金色鑿子，可以幫助找到下一個要前往的區域。
阿杜拉車隊預設有 4 個 NPC，隨著任務的進行，還有 1 個 NPC 可以解鎖：
黑衣幽魂：免費鑑定物品，並使用金幣重置將天賦點數。夏布林：出售武器、護甲、頭盔、手套、圓盾、盾牌、箭筒和腰帶。札卡：出售權杖、ES 盾牌、魔杖、石杖、生命瓶、法力瓶、智慧卷軸、戒指、護身符和符飾。也可以對魔法物品和稀有物品進行變拆解，以獲得蛻變石碎片或富豪石碎片。絲克瑪．阿薩拉：經常說話以進行各種任務。芮蘇 : 可以用金幣來賭未知稀有度的物品。她一開始並不會出現在預設畫面中，而是在擊敗恐懼工程師．魯賈之後解鎖。

name: Traitor's Passage
guide:
Bosses: Balbala, the Traitor (Optional: Djinn Barya) Quests: The Trail of Corruption
The Traitor's Passage is a dark cavernous zone, with the primary objective being to search for an entrance to The Halani Gates .
While exploring the zone, players may encounter Balbala, the Traitor . Defeating Balbala drops a Djinn Barya and unlocks the Trial of the Sekhemas ; the first available method for ascension. During progression, defeating Balbala may be difficult. It is recommended to acquire extra levels and gear before attempting the fight.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 叛徒芭芭拉 (可選: 巨靈之幣 ) 任務: 腐化痕跡
叛徒之路是一個黑暗的洞穴區域，主要目標是尋找通往哈拉妮關口的入口。
在探索這個區域時，遇到丁字路口，有貼符的是叛徒芭芭拉，在毒氣還沒蔓延開來前摸她滾開可以解除毒氣。打敗叛徒芭芭拉會掉落一個芭芭拉的巨靈之幣，並解鎖絲克瑪試煉；這是第一個可用的昇華方法。在劇情過程中，擊敗叛徒芭芭拉可能會有困難。建議在嘗試戰鬥之前先取得額外的等級和裝備。

name: The Halani Gates
guide:
Waypoint: No NPCs: Sekhema Asala Quests: The Trail of Corruption
The Faradun have closed The Halani Gates ! Speak to Sekhema Asala and return to The Ardura Caravan .
Head to the lead cart, speak to both Risu & Sekhema Asala, and use the Desert Map to travel to the Traitor's Passage , an alternate entrance to The Halani Gates .
Bosses: Jamanra, the Risen King ( Uncut Skill Gem Level 7), L'im the Impaler (Optional: Uncut Skill Gem Level 6) Quests: The Trail of Corruption
The Halani Gates is an outdoor zone featuring three gates separated by desert-like areas. Begin by searching for the Summon Asala quest object, who opens gate levers as you protect her from attacking enemies. The primary objective is to open all three gate levers to catch the corrupted caravan.
Upon reaching the third gate lever, it becomes clear that it has been destroyed by the beast. Progress forward to find Jamanra, the Risen King ; a physical and lightning themed boss.
Attempt to defeat Jamanra, who at low HP retreats to the corrupted caravan. In the corner of the arena, stairs appear, take them and chase the corrupted caravan into the sandstorm.
Unfortunately, the sandstorm is impassable for now, return to the Ardura Caravan and speak to Zarka for an Uncut Skill Gem Level 7. Afterwards, head to the lead card and speak to Sekhema Asala to unlock the next three quest objectives.
Author's Note: The next three quest objectives can be completed in the order of your choosing. However, traveling to the Mastodon Badlands and Keth , before travelling to the Valley of the Titans is recommended, to simultaneously complete the Ancient Vows ; an optional quest that provides a permanent character buff. The goal is to complete all three quests for The Horn of the Vastiri quest item.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 崛起之王．賈嫚拉 ( 未切割的技能寶石等級 7), 刺客利姆 (可選: 未切割的技能寶石等級 6) 任務: 腐化痕跡
哈拉妮關口是一個戶外區域，有三個門，被沙漠般的區域分隔開來。一開始要尋找召喚阿薩拉的任務物件，當您保護她不被敵人攻擊時，她就會打開門欄。主要目標是打開所有三個門桿，抓住腐敗的商隊。
到達第三個門桿時，會發現它已被野獸摧毀。繼續前進可以找到崛起之王．賈嫚拉；一個以物理和閃電為主題的頭目。
嘗試打敗崛起之王．賈嫚拉，他的 HP 很低，會退回到腐蝕的大篷車中。在競技場的角落會出現階梯，走過階梯後追著腐蝕的大篷車進入沙暴。
不幸的是，沙暴暫時無法穿過，返回阿杜拉車隊並與札卡說話以獲得技能寶石 7 級。之後前往前面船艙，與絲克瑪．阿薩拉對話，解鎖接下來的三個任務目標。
接下來在前往先前往乳齒象惡地和凱斯城，以便泰坦之谷同時完成遠古誓言；這是一個可選的任務，可提供永久的角色增益。目標是完成所有三個任務，以獲得瓦斯提里的戰角任務物品。

name: Keth
content: Kabala, Constrictor Queen ( 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points )
content_zh_tw: 蟒蛇女王．卡巴拉 ( 2 武器套裝天賦點 )
guide:
Bosses: Kabala, Constrictor Queen (Optional: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points) Quests: The City of Seven Waters ( The Essence of Water : Uncut Support Gem Level 1)
Use the Desert Map to travel to Keth , an open desert-like area, inhabited by skeletal enemies, scarabs, golems and more. The Scarabs and beetles in Keth are lightning enchanted, so take care when encountering them.
Search Keth for the entrance to The Lost City . While doing so, you may encounter Kabala, Constrictor Queen , an optional boss who rewards 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points if defeated.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 蟒蛇女王．卡巴拉 (可選: 2 天賦點數)
使用沙漠地圖前往凱斯城，這是一片類似沙漠的開闊地區，居住著骷髏敵人、刀劍、甲蟲等。凱斯的刀劍和甲蟲都被雷電施了魔法，所以遇到它們時要小心。
蟒蛇女王．卡巴拉 : 這是一個可選的頭目，打敗後會獲得 2 個天賦點數。符文探求者符文陣

name: The Lost City
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: The City of Seven Waters ( The Essence of Water : Uncut Support Gem Level 1), Ancient Vows (Optional: Sun Clan Relic )
The Lost City is an underground area with no quests or bosses. Progress forward and search for the Buried Shrines.
While searching for the Buried Shrines you may find a Kabala Clan Relic . It is recommended to clear either The Lost City or the Buried Shrines until you find it, to then eventually complete the Ancient Vows quest.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 無任務: 七大水域之都 ( 水之精髓 : 未切割的輔助寶石等級 2), 遠古誓言 (可選: 太陽部落聖物 )
失落之城是一個沒有任務或頭目的地下區域。繼續前進，尋找掩埋神殿。
卡巴拉部落聖物 : 凱斯城或失落之城或掩埋神殿會掉落，建議離開前收集到，用來完成遠古誓言任務。

name: Buried Shrines
guide:
Bosses: Azarian, the Forsaken Son Quests: The City of Seven Waters ( The Essence of Water : Uncut Support Gem Level 1), Ancient Vows (Optional: Sun Clan Relic ) Points of Interest: Elemental Shrine (A Magic Rarity Ruby Ring , Sapphire Ring or Topaz Ring )
The Buried Shrines is another underground area and is home to Azarian, the Forsaken Son ; a fire themed boss. Defeating Azarian requires strong positioning, timely dodge rolls and extra fire resistance.
Before fighting Azarian, players can search for the Elemental Shrine, a room which contains 3 Offerings. Choosing an Offering grants a resist ring.
Selecting the Offering of Fire for a Ruby Ring is recommended to gain extra fire resistance before battling Azarian.
In the four corners of Azarian's arena are large destructible pots that when destroyed, engulf a corner of the arena with burning ground. If all four pots are destroyed, a safe area is solely present in the centre of the arena. The burning ground can be mitigated with life regeneration or fire resistance, or avoided entirely by carefully positioning Azarian, to prevent his attacks from breaking the pots.
After defeating Azarian, the entrance to the Water Goddess opens. Speak to The Water Goddess , interact with the Everburning Cinders, ignite the Goddess and loot The Essence of Water quest item. Return to The Ardura Caravan and speak to Zarka for an Uncut Support Gem Level 1.
While searching for Azarian you may find a Kabala Clan Relic . It is recommended to clear either The Lost City or the Buried Shrines until you find it, to then eventually complete the Ancient Vows quest.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 遺忘之子．阿薩里恩任務: 七大水域之都 ( 水之精髓 : 未切割的輔助寶石等級 1), 遠古誓言 (可選: 太陽部落聖物 ) 興趣點: 元素神殿 (Elemental Shrine) (魔法品質紅玉戒指 , 藍玉戒指或黃玉戒指 )
掩埋神殿是另一個地下區域，也是遺忘之子．阿薩里恩的家，這是一個以火為主題的頭目。要擊敗阿齊瑞爾需要很強的走位、及時的閃避和額外的火抗性。
在與阿齊瑞爾對戰前，玩家可以尋找元素神殿 (Elemental Shrine)，這個房間裡有三個祭品。選擇一個祭品可以獲得抗性戒指。
在與阿齊瑞爾對戰前，建議選擇火之祭品來獲得紅玉戒指，以獲得額外的火之抗性。
在阿齊瑞爾競技場的四個角落都有大型的可破壞鍋子，當鍋子被摧毀時，競技場的一角會被燃燒的地面吞噬。如果所有四個鍋子都被摧毀，則只有競技場中央會出現安全區域。您可以使用生命再生或火焰抵抗來減緩燒地的威力，或是小心地為阿齊瑞爾定位，防止他的攻擊破壞鍋子，從而完全避免燒地的威力。
擊敗阿齊瑞爾之後，通往水之女神的入口就會開啟。與水之女神對話，與無盡熾炎互動，點燃女神，獲得水之精髓任務物品。回到阿杜拉車隊，與札卡對話，取得輔助寶石 2 級。
卡巴拉部落聖物 : 凱斯城或凱斯地底城或掩埋神殿會掉落，建議離開前收集到，用來完成遠古誓言任務。

name: Mastodon Badlands
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: A Theft of Ivory ( Mastodon Tusks : Uncut Support Gem Level 1)
Use the Desert Map to travel to the Mastodon Badlands , an open area, inhabited by ritualistic summoners, shielded beasts and more. Search the Mastodon Badlands for the entrance to the Bone Pits.
guide_zh_tw:
使用沙漠地圖前往乳齒象惡地，這是一片開闊的區域，居住著祭祀傳召者、護盾野獸等。在乳齒象惡地搜尋骨坑的入口。
無光通道 : 通往靈魂之井，可以遇到潛伏的生物，深淵的劇情任務深淵事件

name: The Bone Pits
guide:
Bosses: Iktab, the Deathlord & Ekbab, Ancient Steed Quests: A Theft of Ivory ( Mastodon Tusks : Uncut Support Gem Level 1), Ancient Vows (Optional: Sun Clan Relic )
The Bone Pits is another open zone, similar in nature to the Mastodon Badlands. The primary objective is to find and defeat Iktab, the Deathlord & Ekbab, Ancient Steed to acquire the Mastodon Tusks quest item. Once you've acquired the Mastodon Tusks, return to The Ardura Caravan and speak to Zarka for an Uncut Support Gem Level 1.
While searching for Iktab & Ekbab, you may find a Sun Clan Relic . It is recommended to clear the zone until you find it, to then eventually complete the Ancient Vows quest.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 死亡領主．伊克塔 & 遠古之蹄．埃克巴勃任務: 象牙盜匪 ( 乳齒象象牙 : 未切割的輔助寶石等級 2), 遠古誓言 (可選: 太陽部落聖物 )
骨坑是另一個開放區域，與乳齒象惡地的性質類似。主要目標是找到並擊敗死亡領主．伊克塔和遠古之蹄．埃克巴勃以獲得乳齒象象牙任務物品。當您取得乳齒象象牙之後，回到阿杜拉車隊並與札卡交談以獲得輔助寶石等級 2。
在尋找死亡領主．伊克塔和遠古之蹄．埃克巴勃時，您可能會發現太陽部落聖物。建議您先清除這個區域，直到找到它為止，然後才能最終完成遠古誓言任務。
符文探求者符文陣

name: Valley of the Titans
content: Medallion ( 30 % increased Charm Charges gained +1 Charm Slots 30 % increased Charm Effect Duration +1 Charm Slots )
content_zh_tw: 獎章 ( 增加 30 % 護符充能獲取 +1 護符欄位增加 30 % 護符效果持續時間 +1 護符欄位 )
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: A Crown of Stone , Ancient Vows (Optional: 30% increased Charm Charges gained or 15% increased Mana Recovery from Flasks) Points of Interest: 3 Ancient Seals
Use the Desert Map to travel to the Valley of the Titans , an open red-sanded zone, with colossal skeletal giants, skittering golems and more. Search the Valley for 3 Ancient Seals. Interacting with the third Ancient Seal opens the entrance to The Titan Grotto . The point of view zooms out as you approach its entrance.
While progressing through the zone, you can find a Relic Altar near the waypoint. Place the previously found Kabala Clan Relic and Sun Clan Relic into the Altar to choose between the following two character buffs:
30% increased Charm Charges gained 15% increased Mana Recovery from Flasks
If you would like to change your buff you can always return to the Altar and select a different option.
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 石皇冠 , 遠古誓言 (可選) 興趣點: 3 古代封印
使用沙漠地圖前往泰坦之谷，紅沙區有巨大的骷髏巨人、魔像等等，每個叉路口底都會有一個古代封印。搜尋 3 個古代封印，接觸後點傳送門回叉路口。與第三個古代封印互動會開啟泰坦石窟的入口。
在區域中前進的同時，您可以在路點附近找到一個遺跡祭壇。將之前找到的卡巴拉部落聖物和太陽部落聖物放入祭壇，即可在以下兩種角色增益中進行選擇：
增加 30% 護符充能獲取增加 30% 護符效果持續時間
如果想更改您的增益，可以隨時返回祭壇，選擇不同的選項。

options:
30% increased Charm Charges Gained
+1 Charm Slot

30% increased Charm Effect Duration
+1 Charm Slot

name: The Titan Grotto
guide:
Bosses: Zalmarath, the Colossus Quests: A Crown of Stone ( The Flame Ruby : Uncut Support Gem Level 1)
The Titan Grotto is an underground zone inhabited by electrocuting bats, large spiders, goliaths, and more. Players need to search for and defeat Zalmarath, the Colossus; a physical themed boss.
During the fight, Zalmarath casts various arena-covering or arena-altering abilities. Players need to position carefully to avoid damage from either Zalmarath or the environmental dangers he activates. Search for the three Ritual Altars, interact with them, and defeat the newly spawned enemies to cleanse the Ritual.
After defeating Zalmarath, loot The Flame Ruby quest item, return to The Ardura Caravan and speak to Zarka for an Uncut Support Gem Level 1 and The Horn of the Vastiri quest item. Afterwards, use the Desert Map to travel to The Halani Gates . Then, head to the top of The Ardura Caravan and Sound the Horn to clear the Sandstorm.
Once you've cleared the Sandstorm, speak to Sekhema Asala and use the Desert Map to travel to Deshar .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 巨像．札爾瑪拉斯任務: 石皇冠 ( 火焰紅寶石 : 未切割的輔助寶石等級 1)
泰坦石窟是一個地下區域，裡面住著會觸電的蝙蝠、大型蜘蛛、巨人等等。玩家需要尋找並擊敗巨像．札爾瑪拉斯；一個以物理為主題的頭目。
在戰鬥中，札爾瑪拉斯會施放各種覆蓋競技場或改變競技場的能力。玩家需要小心定位，避免受到札爾瑪拉斯或他啟動的環境危險的傷害。尋找三個儀式祭壇，與它們互動，並擊敗新產生的敵人來淨化儀式。
擊敗札爾瑪拉斯之後，取得火焰紅寶石任務物品，回到阿杜拉車隊並與札卡對話以獲得未切割的輔助寶石等級 2 和瓦斯提里的戰角任務物品。之後，使用沙漠地圖前往叛徒之路。然後前往阿杜拉車隊的船頭，點擊吹響號角來清除沙塵暴。
清除沙暴後，與絲克瑪．阿薩拉對話，使用沙漠地圖前往戴斯哈。

name: Deshar
content: Final Letter ( 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points )
content_zh_tw: 遺書 ( 2 武器套裝天賦點 )
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: The Trail of Corruption , Tradition's Toll (Optional: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points)
Deshar is an open zone, inhabited by undead enemies, poisonous vultures, porcupine goliaths and more. Search for the Path of Mourning , and optionally for the Fallen Dekhara for 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points.
After interacting with the Fallen Dekhara, you can loot the Final Letter . Return it to Shambrin in town for your reward.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 無任務: 腐化痕跡 , 傳統的代價 (可選: 2 點天賦點數)
戴斯哈是一個開放的區域，居住著不死的敵人、有毒的禿鷹、豪豬巨人等等。尋找悼念之路，並選擇尋找戰死的部下，以獲得 2 點天賦點數。
與戰死的部下互動後，您可以取得遺書。將它交還給城鎮中的夏布林領取獎勵。
符文探求者符文陣

name: Path of Mourning
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: The Trail of Corruption
The Path of Mourning is built above Deshar , composed of interconnected rooms and narrow fortified walkways. There are no quests or bosses in this zone. Progress forward and search for The Spires of Deshar .
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 腐化痕跡
悼念之路建在戴斯哈的上方，由相互連通的房間和狹窄的強化走道組成。這個區域沒有任務或頭目。繼續前進，尋找戴斯哈尖塔。

name: The Spires of Deshar
content: Sisters of Garukhan ( +10 % to Lightning Resistance )
content_zh_tw: 卡洛翰的姐妹 ( +10 % 閃電抗性 )
guide:
Bosses: Tor Gul, the Defiler Quests: The Trail of Corruption Points of Interest: Sisters of Garukhan (Optional: +10% Lightning Resistance)
The Spires of Deshar is another elevated zone and is home to Tor Gul, the Defiler ; a physical, fire and poison themed boss.
Search for and defeat Tor Gul, the Defiler , then return to the Ardura Caravan, speak to Sekhema Asala, and use the Desert Map to travel to the Dreadnought.
Before leaving the zone, make sure to locate the Sisters of Garukhan. Interact with it to gain +10% Lightning Resistance.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 玷汙者托爾．谷爾任務: 腐化痕跡興趣點: 卡洛翰的姐妹 (可選: +10% 閃電抗性)
戴斯哈尖塔是另一個地勢較高的區域，也是玷汙者托爾．谷爾的家，這是一個以物理、火和毒藥為主題的頭目。
尋找並擊敗玷汙者托爾．谷爾，然後回到阿杜拉車隊，與絲克瑪．阿薩拉對話，並使用沙漠地圖前往無畏隊。
在離開這個區域之前，請務必找到卡洛翰的姐妹。與它互動可獲得 +10% 的閃電抗性。

name: Mawdun Quarry
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: The Trail of Corruption
The Mawdun Quarry has a mix of both narrow passages and open areas. It also contains no immediate quest objectives. Players should navigate through the zone, in search of the Mawdun Mine.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 無任務: 腐化痕跡
莫頓挖石場既有狹窄的通道，也有開闊的區域。這裡也沒有直接的任務目標。玩家應該在這個區域中穿梭，尋找莫頓礦坑。

name: Mawdun Mine
guide:
Bosses: Rudja, the Dread Engineer Quests: The Trail of Corruption
The Mawdun Mine is a narrow winding zone and is home to Rudja, the Dread Engineer ; a fire themed boss, with hard-hitting ranged and melee abilities. Defeating Rudja requires careful positioning and timely dodge rolls. Equipping a Ruby Charm or gear with extra Fire Resistance is recommended.
After defeating Rudja, free Risu, Faridun Defector from their cage and speak to them. Return to town, head to the lead cart and speak to both Risu & Sekhema Asala . Then use the Desert Map to travel to The Halani Gates .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 恐懼工程師．魯賈任務: 腐化痕跡
莫頓礦坑是一個狹窄蜿蜒的區域，也是恐懼工程師．魯賈的家。打敗魯賈需要小心走位和及時的躲避。建議您配備紅玉護符或具備額外火抗的裝備。
擊敗魯賈後，從囚籠中釋放法里登叛變者．芮蘇並交談。前往阿杜拉車隊，與芮蘇和絲克瑪．阿薩拉說話。然後使用沙漠地圖前往叛徒之路。

name: Dreadnought
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 憎惡者．賈嫚拉任務: 腐化痕跡
作者註釋：由於怪物密度很高，而且最後一幕的頭目即將出現，因此建議在WorldAreas#The Dreadnought中耕作額外等級並升級裝備。
無畏隊是第二幕的最後一個區域。繼續朝前進，與憎惡者．賈嫚拉展開最後的戰鬥；這是一個以物理和閃電為主題的頭目。
擊敗憎惡者．賈嫚拉後，絲克瑪．阿薩拉會出現，與她說話，讓她給您最後一拳。之後，回到阿杜拉車隊，下車往西北方向走，與黑衣幽魂說話，最後再與絲克瑪．阿薩拉說話，選擇「前往風沙沼澤」選項以進入第 3 章。
符文探求者地圖左邊出現泰坦之顱，進入符文寶庫完成任務！

name: Sandswept Marsh
guide:
NPCs: The Hooded One ; Zarka Bosses: Rootdredge (Optional: Uncut Skill Gem Level 9) Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: Orok Campfire (Optional: Lesser Jeweller's Orb ), Hanging Tree (Optional: Magic Rings)
The Sandswept Marsh is the first town in Act 3. Look for a natural crossing at the edge of town and take it to transition into a combat zone. The primary quest objective is to cross the Sandswept Marsh, in search of a Ziggurat Encampment .
There are however, two secrets and one optional boss, which may provide valuable upgrades for your character:
Orok Campfire: Basket containing Lesser Jeweller's Orb Hanging Tree: Corpses containing Magic Rings Rootdredge : A unique physical & fire themed boss that drops an Uncut Skill Gem Level 9
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 黑衣幽魂 ; 札卡頭目: 根淤 (可選: 未切割的技能寶石等級 9) 興趣點: 歐洛克營火 (可選: 低階工匠石 ), 吊樹 (可選: 魔法戒指)
風沙沼澤是第三章的第一個城鎮。在城鎮邊緣尋找一個天然的渡口，然後走過這個渡口進入戰鬥區。主要的任務目標是穿越風沙沼澤，尋找高地神塔營地。
不過，這裡有兩個秘密和一個可選的頭目，可能會為您的角色提供寶貴的升級：
歐洛克營火: 裝有低階工匠石的木籃吊樹: 包含魔法戒指的屍體根淤 : 獨特的物理與火焰主題頭目，會掉落技能寶石。等級 9

name: Ziggurat Encampment
guide:
NPCs: The Hooded One , Alva , Oswald , Servi
The Ziggurat Encampment is the second town in Act 3.
Speak to the treasure hunters, Alva and Oswald , and then to The Hooded One to learn more about lowering the water levels. Take the exit to the Jungle Ruins , near the top of the town.
The Ziggurat Encampment has 4 NPCs by default:
The Hooded One : Identifies items for free and Refunds Passive Points for Gold. Alva : accompanies you for various quests. Oswald : Sells Weapons, Body Armours, Helms, Gloves, Bloots, Shields, Quivers & Belts. Oswald can also purchase Idols for Gold. Servi : Sells Sceptres, ES Shields, Wands, Staves, Life Flasks, Mana Flasks, Wisdom Scrolls, Rings, Amulets & Charms. Servi can also Disenchant Magic Items & Rare Items for Transmutation or Regal Shards. Furthermore, Servi can also provide “Local Knowledge,” a special version of the world map with information icons; click on an icon to hear zone specific dialogue.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 黑衣幽魂 , 艾瓦 , 奧斯瓦德 , 瑟維
高地神塔營地是第三章的第二個城鎮。
跟尋寶者艾瓦和奧斯瓦德說話，然後再跟黑衣幽魂說話，了解更多關於降低水位的資訊。從出口前往叢林遺跡，靠近城鎮的頂端。
高地神塔營地預設有 4 個 NPC：
黑衣幽魂 : 免費鑑定物品，並使用金幣重置天賦點數。艾瓦 : 陪您完成各種任務。奧斯瓦德 : 販售武器、護甲、頭盔、手套、盾牌、箭袋和腰帶。瑟維 : 出售權杖、ES 盾牌、法杖、魔杖、生命瓶、魔力瓶、智慧卷軸、戒指、護身符和護符。也可以對魔法物品和稀有物品進行拆解，以獲得蛻變石碎片或富豪石碎片。此外，也可以提供「當地知識」，這是一個特殊版本的世界地圖，上面有資訊圖示；按一下圖示就可以聽到特定區域的對話。

name: Infested Barrens
guide:
NPCs: Alva Bosses: None Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: Troubled Camp, Chimeral Wetlands, The Azak Bog
The Infested Barrens is an outdoor zone that combines a forested jungle with narrow anthill columns.
The primary quest objective is to search for The Matlan Waterways , however it is currently submerged underwater! Collect the waypoint near its entrance, summon and speak to Alva , and search for the Chimeral Wetlands .
Also connected to the Infested Barrens is The Azak Bog , an optional side zone with a unique boss that provides +30 Spirit and a Persistent Skill gem.
Additionally, while exploring the zone you may find another Troubled Camp. Similar to the Jungle Ruins, the Troubled Camp has a Vendor that sells items and a chest that drops a rare item.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 艾瓦興趣點: 動亂營地, 龍蜥濕地
感染荒地是一個結合森林叢林與狹窄蟻丘柱的戶外區域。
尋找龍蜥濕地。
動亂營地: 與叢林廢墟類似，也有一個販賣物品的賣家和一個掉落稀有物品的箱子。跟NPC聊天可以取得龍蜥濕地的位置。

name: The Matlan Waterways
guide:
Waypoint: No Bosses: None Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: Narag's Hut (Optional)
The Matlan Waterways is an open zone composed of a series of interconnected canals. Players need to interact with many levers to drain water-filled sections to progress forward.
At the end of the zone, players encounter one final, larger lever. Interact with it, return to town, speak to Alva at the base of the Ziggurat and enter The Drowned City .
Note: While progressing through The Matlan Waterways , players may find Narag's hut. Host to a rare enemy that drops a rare weapon.
guide_zh_tw:
興趣點: 納瑞格的小屋 (可選), 阿札克泥沼
傳送至叢林遺跡，瑪特蘭水道是一個開放區域，由一系列互相連接的運河組成。玩家需要與許多壓桿互動，排出充滿水的部分，才能向前邁進。
在區域的盡頭，玩家會遇到最後一個較大的壓桿。與它互動後回到城鎮，在金字形神塔的底部與艾瓦說話，然後進入淹沒之城。
遇到瑟維告知旁邊的阿札克泥沼區域有任務需要協助，一個可選擇的側邊區域，有獨特的頭目，提供 +30 精魂和精魂寶石。
納瑞格的小屋: 這裡有稀有敵人，會掉落稀有武器。

name: Jungle Ruins
content: Mighty Silverfist ( 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points )
content_zh_tw: 神威銀拳 ( 2 武器套裝天賦點 )
guide:
Bosses: Mighty Silverfist (Optional: 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points) Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: The Venom Crypts , Troubled Camp, Jungle Grave
The Jungle Ruins is an open forested area. The primary quest objective is to search for Infested Barrens and processing to The Matlan Waterways .
There are however, two secrets, one optional unique boss and one side zone that are of potential interest:
Mighty Silverfist : is a hard-hitting physical damage boss that provides 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points if defeated. Precise Dodge Rolls are required to avoid either his swing or slam attacks. Might Silverfist also has a damaging Roll ability which is especially lethal if your character is low on armour. The Venom Crypts : is an optional but recommended side zone that when completed, provides a permanent character buff. The entrance to the Venom Crypts is located near the Waypoint in the Jungle Ruins. Troubled Camp: has a Vendor that may sell items of interest & drops rare items from a chest. Jungle Grave: is a gravesite that when interacted with, summons Servi, who allows you to select one unidentified rare belt as a reward.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 神威銀拳 (可選: 2 天賦點數) 興趣點: 劇毒墓穴 , 動亂營地, 叢林墓園 , 瑪特蘭水道
叢林遺跡是一片開闊的森林地带。主要的任務目標是尋找感染荒地。
尋找瑪特蘭水道，不過目前它被淹没在水底！收集其入口附近的路標，傳召並與艾瓦對話。
有兩個秘密、一個可選的獨特頭目和一個側邊區域可能會引起玩家的興趣：
動亂營地：有一個販賣商，可能會出售您感興趣的物品，並會從箱子裡掉下稀有物品。可以詢問她感染荒地的方位。叢林墓園：是一個墳墓，與它互動時可召喚瑟維，會讓您選擇一條未鑑定稀有腰帶作為獎勵。神威銀拳：是一個會造成強烈物理傷害的頭目，如果擊敗它，會提供 2 點天賦點數。需要精確的閃避來避開他的揮拳或猛擊攻擊。劇毒墓穴：這是一個可選但建議使用的側邊區域，完成後會提供永久的角色增益。入口位於叢林廢墟的路點附近。符文探求者符文陣

name: The Venom Crypts
content: Venom Draught ( 25 % increased Stun Threshold 30 % increased Elemental Ailment Threshold 25 % increased Mana Regeneration Rate )
content_zh_tw: 劇毒藥水 ( 增加 25 % 暈眩門檻增加 30 % 元素異常狀態門檻增加 25 %魔力回復率 )
guide:
Waypoint: No Bosses: None Quests: The Slithering Dead (Optional: 25% increased Stun Threshold, or 30% increased Elemental Ailment Threshold, or 25% increased Mana Regeneration Rate)
The Venom Crypts is an overgrown underground tomb, inhabited by venomous cobras, tentacle miscreations, rats and more. Search the Venom Crypts for Corpse-snake Venom and return it to Servi in town, who offers you a permanent character buff as a reward:
25% increased Stun Threshold 30% increased Elemental Ailment Threshold 25% increased Mana Regeneration Rate
Warning: you cannot change your choice later on!
Cruel reward:
+10% to Chaos Resistance +5 to all Attributes 15% reduced Slowing Potency of Debuffs on You
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 滑行死者 (可選: 增加 25% 暈眩門檻或增加 30% 元素異常門檻或增加 25% 魔力回復率 )
劇毒墓穴是一個雜草叢生的地下墳墓，裡面住著有毒的眼鏡蛇、觸手怪、老鼠等等。搜尋屍蛇毒液，然後交回給鎮上的瑟維，他會提供您一個永久的角色 BUFF 作為獎勵：
增加 25% 暈眩門檻增加 30% 元素異常門檻增加 25% 魔力回復率
警告：您之後將無法更改您的選擇！
在取得任務物品後，旁邊會有小門出來，會在感染荒地旁。
符文探求者符文陣

name: Chimeral Wetlands
guide:
Bosses: Xyclucian, the Chimera Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: Ravaged Camp, Toxic Bloom, Temple of Chaos
The Chimeral Wetlands is a dense jungle filled with toxic flora and undead explorers, and is home to Xylucian, the Chimera; a tri-elemental, physical and chaos themed boss.
Begin by searching the Chimeral Wetlands for the entrance to Jiquani's Machinarium , guarded by Xylucian; a challenging boss with a large array of abilities and mechanics.
After defeating Xylucian, loot the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum quest item and progress forward to Jiquani's Machinarium .
Connected to the Chimeral Wetlands is the Temple of Chaos; the second available method for ascension. During progression, completing the Temple of Chaos may be difficult. It is recommended to acquire extra levels and gear before attempting the ascendancy trial.
While exploring the Chimeral Wetlands, players may encounter the following two secrets
Ravaged Camp: contains a chest that drops a rare item. Toxic Bloom: contains a Rare Monster that drops a Magic Amulet when killed.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 龍蜥．欽路錫安興趣點: 殘摧營地 , 劇毒之花 , 混沌神殿
龍蜥濕地是一片茂密的叢林，裡面充滿了有毒的植物群和不死的探險者，也是龍蜥．欽路錫安的老家；龍蜥．欽路錫安是一個以三元素、物理和混沌為主題的頭目。
首先在龍蜥濕地搜尋吉卡尼的機械迷城的入口，該入口由欽路錫安把守；欽路錫安是一個具挑戰性的頭目，擁有許多能力和機制。
擊敗欽路錫安之後，搶到龍蜥最後通牒雕刻任務物品，然後前往吉卡尼的機械迷城。
與龍蜥濕地相連的是混沌神殿，這是第二個可用的昇華方法。在劇情過程中，完成混沌神殿可能會有困難。建議在嘗試昇華試煉之前先取得額外的等級和裝備。
在探索奇美拉濕地時，玩家可能會遇到以下兩個秘密
殘摧營地：包含一個掉落稀有物品的箱子。劇毒之花：包含一個稀有怪物，殺死後會掉落一個魔法護符。

name: Jiquani's Machinarium
content: Blackjaw, the Remnant ( +10 % to Fire Resistance 1 Broken Boss Faces )
content_zh_tw: 遺忘的黑顎 ( +10 % 火焰抗性 1 打爛頭目的臉 )
guide:
NPCs: Alva Bosses: Blackjaw, the Remnant (Optional: The Flame Core: Grants +10% to Fire Resistance) Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: 4 Small Soul Cores
Jiquani's Machinarium is an underground puzzle-like zone that requires Small Soul Core s to unlock different sections:
One Small Soul Core is required to unlock the initial puzzle. A second Small Soul Core is required to unlock the entrance to Jiquani's Sanctum . (Optional) gain access to the optional boss: Blackjaw, the Remnant (Optional) a secret room with loot.
Blackjaw is a physical and fire themed boss; who uses a combination of devastating slams and fire spells which can be avoided with either Dodge Roll invincibility frames or careful positioning. Defeating Blackjaw provides The Flame Core , which when consumed provides a permanent +10% to Fire Resistance buff.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 艾瓦頭目: 遺忘的黑顎 (可選: 火焰核心 : 賦予 +10% 火焰抗性) 任務: 瓦爾．不朽興趣點: 4 小型靈魂核心
吉卡尼的機械迷城是一個類似地下解謎區，需要小型靈魂核心來解鎖不同的區塊：
需要一個小型靈魂核心來解鎖最初的謎題。解鎖吉卡尼的聖域的入口需要第二個小型靈魂核心。可選: 頭目遺忘的黑顎 ( 火焰核心 : 賦予 +10% 火焰抗性)。可選: 有戰利品的密室。
黑顎是一個以物理和火焰為主題的頭目；他會使用毀滅性的重擊和火焰咒語，玩家可以使用閃避捲軸無敵框或小心走位來避開。擊敗黑顎可以獲得火焰核心，消耗此核心可以永久獲得 +10% 的火焰抗性。

name: Jiquani's Sanctum
guide:
NPCs: Alva Bosses: Zicoatl, Warden of the Core Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: 2 Medium Soul Cores, Paquate's Mechanism
Jiquani's Sanctum is another underground puzzle-like zone that requires two Medium Soul Core s to activate Zicoatl, Warden of the Core ; a physical and lightning themed unique boss.
Defeating Zicoatly provides a Large Soul Core , which is used to open the entrance to The Matlan Waterways . Begin by summoning and speaking to Alva , located near the start of the area and then search for two Medium Soul Core s. The Soul Cores are randomly located and need to be placed into two separate generators. Once you've activated the generators, speak to Alva once more and interact with the Large Soul Core to begin the fight.
Zicoatl has a wide array of physical and lightning abilities. Most abilities have a telegraphed windup that can be avoided by playing in melee range and Dodge Rolling behind the boss. One of Zicoatl's most lethal abilities is his triangular expanding slam. Stand near the vertices to avoid taking damage.
After defeating Zicoatl, loot the Large Soul Core , return to the Infested Barrens and interact with the Stone Altar to resurface the entrance to The Matlan Waterways .
Note: while clearing Jiquani's Sanctum you may discover a corruption altar, allowing the player to unpredictably modify an item.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 艾瓦頭目: 核心守衛．茲科亞特興趣點: 2 中型靈魂核心 , 帕科特的機關
吉卡尼的聖域是另一個類似地下解謎區，需要兩個中型靈魂核心才能啟動核心守衛．茲科亞特；這是一個以物理和閃電為主題的獨特頭目。
打敗核心守衛．茲科亞特會提供一個大型靈魂核心，用來打開通往瑪特蘭水道的入口。首先要召喚位於區域起點附近的艾瓦並與之對話，然後尋找兩個中型靈魂核心。靈魂核心的位置是隨機的，需要分別放入兩個發電機中。啟動發電機後，再跟艾瓦說一次話，然後與大型靈魂核心互動，就可以開始戰鬥了。
核心守衛．茲科亞特擁有各式各樣的物理和閃電能力。大多數的能力都有一個閃點傳送，只要在近戰範圍內使用閃避就可以避開。核心守衛．茲科亞特最致命的能力之一是他的三角形擴張猛擊。站在頂點附近可避免受到傷害。
擊敗核心守衛．茲科亞特之後，掠奪大型靈魂核心，回到感染荒地並與石壇互動，重新浮現通往瑪特蘭水道的入口。
注意：在通過吉卡尼的聖域時，可能會發現汙染祭壇，可以腐化物品。

name: The Azak Bog
content: Ignagduk, the Bog Witch ( +30 to Spirit 1 Broken Boss Faces )
content_zh_tw: 沼澤女巫．尹娜杜克 ( +30 精魂 1 打爛頭目的臉 )
guide:
Bosses: Ignagduk, the Bog Witch ( Gembloom Skull : +30 Spirit, Uncut Spirit Gem Level 10: Creates a Persistent Buff Skill Gem at Level 10) Quests: Tribal Vengeance (Optional: A Magic Rarity Thawing, Staunching, Antidote, Dousing or Grounding Charm) Points of Interest: Flameskin Ritual
The Azak Bog is an outdoor zone, featuring narrow wooden walkways, wooden encampments, dangerous fire themed enemies, and the unique Boss: Ignagduk, the Bog Witch .
Upon entering the zone, summon and speak to Servi to begin the Tribal Vengeance quest to defeat Ignaduk.
Ignaduk is a multi-phase, physical and fire themed boss, with many spell abilities. To mitigate Ignaduks fire damage, in addition to equipping a Ruby Charm or fire resistance gear, players can search for the Flameskin Ritual. Interacting with all the effigies surrounding the ritual temporarily buffs your characters with Ignagduk's Harvest: significantly increasing fire resistance.
Acquiring Ignaduk's Harvest can significantly reduce the difficulty of the upcoming boss fight.
After defeating Ignaduk, loot the Gembloom Skull and consume it for a +30 Spirit Buff and an Uncut Spirit Gem Level 10. Head to town and return Ignagduk's Ghastly Spear to Servi for a Magic Rarity Charm. Select one charm and progress further.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 沼澤女巫．尹娜杜克 ( 寶石花顱骨 : +30 精魂, 精魂寶石等級 10) 任務: 部落復仇 (可選: 魔法品質護符) 興趣點: 火膚儀式
阿札克泥沼是一個戶外區域，這裡有狹窄的木制走道、木制營地、以火為主題的危險敵人，以及獨一無二的頭目：沼澤女巫．尹娜杜克。
火膚儀式: 與儀式周圍的所有遺像互動，可以暫時為您的角色加持尹娜杜克的收穫：大幅增加火抗。儀式會指向頭目的位置。
尹娜杜克是一個多階段、以物理和火焰為主題的頭目，擁有許多法術能力。為了減輕尹娜杜克的火焰傷害，除了裝備紅玉護符或抗火裝備之外，玩家還可以尋找火膚儀式儀式。
獲得尹娜杜克的收穫可以大幅降低接下來的頭目戰的難度。
擊敗尹娜杜克之後，掠奪傑洛特顱骨，並消耗它以獲得 +30 精魂和精魂寶石等級 10。前往城鎮，將尹娜杜克的幽暗長矛交還給瑟維以獲得魔法稀有護符。選擇一個護符後繼續前進。

name: The Drowned City
guide:
Bosses: None Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: Secret Gold Cellars
The Drowned City is an open zone composed of water-damaged ruins and is inhabited with large packs of cannibals, colossal volatile enemies who explode on death and more. This zone also introduces the drowning mechanic, a moving teal orb that reduces vision, and if you stand in it for too long, brings your character to a short and timely end.
The primary quest objective is to travel to the Apex of Filth . However, players can also choose to enter The Molten Vault , an optional side zone.
While navigating The Drowned City , you may come across underground cellars, filled with enemies, gold and loot.
guide_zh_tw:
興趣點: 惡臭房舍
在高地神塔營地往東邊樓梯下層走，淹沒之城是一個由被水破壞的廢墟所組成的開放區域，裡面居住著大群的食人族、死後會爆炸的巨型易變敵人等等。這個區域也引進了溺水機制，一個會移動的茶色球體會降低視力，如果您站在球體上太久，您的角色就會短暫且及時地結束。
主要的任務目標是前往污垢頂峰。不過，玩家也可以選擇進入熔岩寶庫，這是一個可選的側邊區域。
惡臭房舍: 裡面充滿了敵人、黃金和戰利品。

name: The Molten Vault
guide:
Bosses: Mektul, the Forgemaster (Optional) Quests: Treasures of Utzaal ( Uncut Skill Gem Level 10)
The Molten Vault is an indoor forge inhabited by Mektul, the Forgemaster ; a physical and fire themed boss. Defeating Mektul rewards the player with an Uncut Skill Gem Level 10.
To find Mektul, begin by searching for a large vat of molten gold. Pull the nearby lever to open the path forward. Follow the flow of molten gold, exploring side rooms as alternate paths, when reaching dead ends. Continue following the flow of gold until you reach the boss Arena. Pull the Sluice Gate Lever and take the lift down to Mektul.
Mektul is a challenging boss with a strict time limit. Players may need to improve their gear and level up before attempting the fight.
Players have less than four minutes to defeat Mektul before molten gold completely covers the aqueduct.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 冶煉師範．梅克圖 (可選) 任務: 奧札爾寶藏 ( 未切割的技能寶石等級 10)
熔岩寶庫是一個室內鍛造場，裡面住著冶煉師範．梅克圖，他是一個以物理和火為主題的頭目。打敗梅克圖會讓玩家獲得技能寶石等級 10。
要找到冶煉師範．梅克圖，首先要尋找一大桶熔金。拉動附近的槓桿，打開前進的道路。沿著熔金的流向前進，到達死胡同時探索側邊的房間作為替代路徑。繼續沿著金流前進，直到抵達頭目競技場。拉起水閘拉桿，搭乘升降機下到冶煉師範．梅克圖。
冶煉師範．梅克圖是個具有挑戰性的頭目，有嚴格的時間限制。玩家可能需要先提升裝備和等級再嘗試對戰。
在熔金完全覆蓋水渠之前，玩家只有不到四分鐘的時間打敗冶煉師範．梅克圖。掉落卡瑪薩之錘，同賽季只要解一次。

name: Apex of Filth
guide:
Bosses: Queen of Filth Quests: Legacy of the Vaal Points of Interest: Cauldron Keeper (Optional)
The Apex of Filth is an open runic area, once again inhabited by large packs of cannibals, volatile exploding enemies, shamans and more. The Filthy Crone's in particular pay homage to Path of Exiles 1's Doedre and use similar abilities such as casting curses or firing physical projectile attacks.
Located in the centre of the zone is the Queen of Filth , a physical and chaos themed unique boss. Despite their appearance, the Queen of Filth is extremely mobile and requires careful positioning and timely Dodge Roll's to survive. Furthermore, similar to the Filthy Crone's encountered earlier, the Queen of Filth can cast circular patches of stationary cursed ground; avoid standing in these areas to prevent being debuffed.
After defeating the Queen of Filth , loot the Temple Door Idol quest item, return to town and speak to Alva , opening the entrance to the Temple of Kopec .
While searching for the Queen of Filth, players may find the Cauldron Keeper ; a friendly Filthy Crone who sells caster gear and jewellery. Players can also find Red Mushroom , Green Mushroom , and Blue Mushroom s, which can be placed into the Cauldron Keeper's cauldron for a Life and Mana Flask reward.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 污垢女王興趣點: 鍋爐守護者 (可選)
污垢頂峰是一個開放的符文區域，再次居住著大群的食人族、易爆炸的敵人、薩滿等等。
位於區域中心的污垢女王，是一個以物理和混沌為主題的獨特頭目。儘管外表如此，污垢女王非常好動，需要小心走位和及時的閃避捲才能生存。污垢女王施放圓形的固定詛咒地帶；避免站在這些區域，以免受到減益。
擊敗污垢女王後，掠奪神殿大門神像任務物品，回到鎮上與艾瓦對話，開啟科佩克神殿的入口。
鍋爐守護者 : 一個友善的骯髒老婦，她會出售施法者裝備和首飾。玩家也可以找到紅色蘑菇 , 綠色蘑菇 , 和藍色蘑菇，將三個蘑菇放入大鍋看守人的大鍋中，可以獲得有品質的生命和魔力藥劑的獎勵。可多次完成。

guide:
Waypoint: No NPCs: Alva Bosses: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun Quests: Legacy of the Vaal
The Temple of Kopec is an enclosed temple, inhabited by fiery enemies and introduces a unique environmental hazard: an indoor sun that applies a stacking burning debuff when standing in its light. Stay in the shade to avoid being burnt to a crisp.
Carefully search the corners of the Temple for stairs to ascend to the top floor, to find Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun ; a fire themed boss.
Follow Alva through the gateway to the Vaal Empire moments before the Cataclysm. Take the steps down to Utzaal of the past to continue your journey.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 艾瓦頭目: 豔陽神聖主教．凱亞祖利
科佩克神殿是一座封閉的神殿，裡面住著火熱的敵人，並帶來獨特的環境危險：室內的太陽，站在太陽光下會累積灼傷的減益。請待在陰涼處，以免被燒成焦炭。
仔細尋找神殿的角落，尋找可以登上頂樓的樓梯，找到豔陽神聖主教．凱亞祖利；一個以火為主題的頭目。
擊敗豔陽神聖主教．凱亞祖利後，呼喚艾瓦讓他查看平台，回到營地。
跟著艾瓦穿越崎點。走下台階到過去的奧札爾繼續您的旅程。

name: Kingsmarch
guide:
NPCs: Doryani ; The Hooded One ; Alva ; Rog ; Tujen ; Ange ; Dannig ; Makoru ; Kanu
Kingsmarch is the first town in Act 4.
Dannig : Sells Weapons, Body Armours, Helms, Gloves, Boots, Shields, Quivers & Belts. Rog : Sells Sceptres, ES Shields, Wands, Staves, Life Flasks, Mana Flasks, Wisdom Scrolls, Rings, Amulets & Charms. Rog can also Disenchant Magic Items & Rare Items for Transmutation or Regal Shards. Tujen : allows you to Gamble Gold for Items of an unknown rarity. Ange : Unlocks Asynchronous Trading, Hideout Selection and provides access to the Currency Exchange. Makoru : Facilitates sailing to various islands surrounding Kingsmarch.
Speak to Doryani , Alva , Rog , Tujen and Ange . Then head down the dock towards the moored ship and speak to Kanu and Makoru . Sprint back up the dock and take the Boat Charter from Rog . Then sprint down the docks once more, and speak to Makoru to set sail to an island of your choosing.
Optionally, consider sailing towards the following islands before beginning your progression for potential gear upgrades:
Arastas : Speak to Servitor Marius for a Caster Shop. Ngakanu : Speak to Ruhaki for a Blacksmith Shop.
Non-Linear Act Act 4 is non-linear, allowing you to complete the act in any order you'd like. The zone order listed below is only a suggestion; based on an evaluation of quest rewards and boss difficulty.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 多里亞尼 ; 黑衣幽魂 ; 艾瓦 ; 羅格 ; 圖貞 ; 安潔 ; 丹尼格 ; 瑪寇魯 ; 卡努
金司馬區是第四章的第一個城鎮。
丹尼格 : 販售武器、胸甲、頭盔、手套、鞋子、盾牌、箭袋及腰帶。羅格 : 販售權杖、能量護盾盾牌、長杖、法杖、生命藥劑、魔力藥劑、智慧卷軸、戒指、項鍊與護符。羅格亦可為魔法物品與稀有物品進行祛魔，以換取蛻變石碎片或富豪石碎片。圖貞 : 以金幣賭博換取稀有度未知的物品。安潔 : 解鎖非同步交易、藏身處選擇功能，並提供通貨兌換服務。瑪寇魯 : 便於航行至金司馬區周邊的各個島嶼。
與羅格交談取得船隻特許證，沿著碼頭走向繫泊的船隻，與卡努和瑪寇魯對話啟航前往你選擇的島嶼。
若需提升裝備等級，可考慮在推進主線任務前先前往下列島嶼：
阿拉塔斯：與僕從瑪里亞斯對話可開啟法師商店。尼加卡努：與盧哈奇對話可開啟鐵匠鋪。
第四章採用非線性設計，可依個人喜好自由選擇任務完成順序。以下區域順序僅供參考，係基於任務獎勵與首領難度評估後所建議。

name: Isle of Kin
guide:
Boss: The Blind Beast (Optional: Greater Blank Runes) Quests: The Search , Land of the Kin , Forgotten Bounty (Optional) Points of Interest: Beast Pen, Fossilised Formation , Flayed Sailor , Voltaxic Spire
The Isle of Kin is a sulphite quarry inhabited by large packs of swarming Kin and their subdued behemoths. The primary quest objective is to search for the Volcanic Warrens; to investigate what has riled the Kin up and search for lost Weapon Pieces.
Additionally, there is one optional unique boss, one optional quest objective, and 3 secrets to consider:
The Blind Beast : is an aggressive physical and lightning damage boss that provides Greater Blank Runes if defeated. Beast Pen: contains a rare beast that drops an Uncut Support Gem Level 4. Fossilised Formation: contains a Lesser Jeweller's Orb . Voltaxic Spire: Provides the Sulphite Infusion buff, increasing your movement speed, elemental resistance and damage until you leave the zone. Flayed Sailor: along the shores you find the body of a sailor, which drops a Torn Map Piece . Used to complete the optional Forgotten Bounty quest.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 眼盲巨獸 (可選: 高階空白符文) 任務: 大搜索 , 金氏族地 , 忘卻寶物 (可選) 興趣點: 獸欄, 化石岩層 , 被剝皮的水手 , 魔痕尖塔
金氏島是一座硫磺礦場，棲息著成群結隊的金氏族生物及其馴服的巨獸。主要任務目標是尋找火山迷窟，調查金氏族暴動的根源，並搜尋遺失的武器碎片。
此外，還需考慮一個可選的傳奇頭目、一個可選的任務目標，以及3個祕密：
眼盲巨獸 :是一隻具侵略性的物理與閃電傷害首領，擊敗後可提供高階空白符文。獸欄: 包含著一隻稀有的野獸，會掉落未切割的輔助寶石等級4. 化石岩層 : 包含低階工匠石 . 被剝皮的水手 : 沿著海岸線，你發現一名水手的遺體，遺體掉落了一片撕碎的地圖碎片。此物品用於完成可選任務忘卻寶物。集齊 4 張藏寶圖碎片，去掠奪者之角找船長瑪寇魯可解鎖符文探求者的剩餘符文組合。魔痕尖塔 : 提供「亞硫酸鹽注入」增益效果，使你的移動速度、元素抗性與傷害值提升，此效果將持續至你離開該區域為止。

name: Volcanic Warrens
guide:
Bosses: Krutog, Lord of Kin Quests: The Search , Land of the Kin Points of Interest: Volcanic Nest
The Volcanic Warrens is a vast volcanic cavern packed with Kin, behemoths, molten imps and volcanic golems. Search the caverns for the throne room, host to Krutog, Lord of Kin, a physical and lightning themed boss.
Defeat Krutog and free Matiki from their cage. Return to town and speak to them once more on the boat, to unlock a new island, the Eye of Hinekora . The Eye of Hinekora is host to numerous rewards but includes a difficult boss fight. Thus, before sailing to the Eye of Hinekora , travel to Kedge Bay , to maximise character power in advance.
Note: While clearing this zone you may encounter the Volcanic Nest Secret, housing two rare Volcanic Golem s. Each dropping a Magic or Rare Ring on death.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 金氏領主．克魯托克任務: 大搜索 , 金氏族地興趣點: 火山之巢
火山迷窟是一座充斥著金氏族、巨獸、熔岩小惡魔與火山傀儡的廣袤火山洞穴。探索洞穴深處的王座廳，那裡坐鎮著金氏領主．克魯托克——一位以物理與閃電為主題的首領。
點擊返回船上，前往凱吉灣。
注意：清理此區域時，您可能會發現「火山之巢秘境」，內有兩隻稀有的火山魔像。每隻死亡時會掉落一枚魔法戒指或稀有戒指。

name: Kedge Bay
guide:
Quests: The Search , Dark Mists , Forgotten Bounty (Optional) Points of Interest: Abandoned Ship , Dead Man's Chest
Kedge Bay is a shipwrecked strand, home to shrieking gulls, drowned crawlers, and sea-rotted skeletal sailors. Progress ahead to Journey's End , in search of additional Weapon Pieces.
While clearing this zone you may find:
Dead Man's Chest: contains a second Torn Map Piece , used to complete the optional Forgotten Bounty quest. Abandoned Ship Secret: contains a chest that drops a guaranteed Lesser Jeweller's Orb .
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 大搜索 , 暗黑迷霧 , 忘卻寶物 (可選) 興趣點: 廢船 , 亡者之箱
凱吉灣是座沉船殘骸遍布的海灘，棲息著尖嘯的海鷗、溺斃的爬行生物，以及被海水腐蝕的骷髏水手。繼續前進至旅程之末，尋找更多武器碎片。
在清理此區域時，可能會發現：
亡者之箱：內含第二片撕碎的地圖碎片，用於完成可選任務忘卻寶物。廢船祕密：藏有寶箱，必定掉落低階工匠石。

name: Journey's End
guide:
NPCs: Tujen , Freya Hartlin Bosses: Captain Hartlin Quests: The Search , Dark Mists
Journey's End is another debris filled strand, teeming with undead explorers, ghostly creatures, and rotting soul-catchers. Upon entering the area, you encounter a trapped Freya Hartlin , who Tujen dearly wants to rescue. Summon and speak to Tujen , to gain your next objective: a quest to search for and defeat Captain Hartlin , a physical and cold themed boss.
After defeating Captain Hartlin , loot the Verisium , return to town and speak to Dannig to acquire Verisium Spikes . Return to Journey's End and interact with the Karui Totem's to free Freya Hartlin .
Surprise! Freya Hartlin is actually Omniphobia, Fear Manifest . Survive the madness, defeat Omniphobia, Fear Manifest , return to town and speak to Tujen for an Uncut Skill Gem Level 13 and 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 圖貞 , 芙雷雅．哈特林頭目: 哈特林統帥任務: 大搜索 , 暗黑迷霧
旅程之末是另一條遍佈殘骸的通道，充斥著不死探險者、幽靈生物與腐朽的靈魂捕手。進入區域後，你將遇見受困的芙雷雅．哈特林，圖貞渴望將她救出。召喚並與圖貞對話，即可獲得下個目標：尋找並擊敗哈特林統帥——一位以物理攻擊與冰霜為主題的首領。
擊敗哈特林統帥後，搜刮維里西姆錠，返回城鎮與丹尼格對話以取得維里西姆尖矢。重返旅程之末，與卡魯圖騰互動以解救芙雷雅．哈特林。
驚喜！芙雷雅．哈特林其實是恐懼造物．歐姆弗畢亞。在瘋狂中生存下來，擊敗恐懼造物．歐姆弗畢亞，返回城鎮與圖貞對話，即可獲得未切割的技能寶石等級13 和 +2 天賦點數。

name: Whakapanu Island
guide:
Bosses: Great White One (Optional) Quests: The Search , Whakapanu Island , Tribal Medicine (Optional), Forgotten Bounty (Optional) Points of Interest: Sharkpit, Crabshell Cavern , Petrified Pirate
Whakapanu Island is an undisturbed paradise, inhabited by thriving coconut crabs, scorpion monkey's, towering elephant tortoise and more. Search the island for an entrance to the Singing Caverns .
While exploring the island you may encounter the following bosses or points of interest:
Crabshell Cavern: Home to a large overgrown rare crab, which drops an Uncut Support Gem Level 4. Petrified Pirate: drops another Torn Map Piece . Used to complete the optional Forgotten Bounty quest. Great White One : a large overgrown Shark, located at the Shark Pit , that when defeated drops a Shark Fin . The Shark Fin can be returned to Kaimana immediately at Ngakanu island or at the end of the act in town, for a choice between the following rewards: Kaom's Lesson Rakiata's Lesson Note: at the end of the act, Kaimana is found on the platform at the end of the dock, opposite of the Ship.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 大白鯊 (可選) 任務: 大搜索 , 瓦卡帕努島 , 部落藥術 (可選), 忘卻寶物 (可選) 興趣點: 蟹殼洞穴 , 石化海盜 , 大白鯊
瓦卡帕努島是一座未受干擾的天堂，棲息著繁盛的椰子蟹、蠍猴、高聳的象龜等生物。探索島嶼，尋找通往吟謠洞窟的入口。
在探索島嶼時，可能會遇到以下頭目或景點：
蟹殼洞穴：棲息著一隻巨大過生的稀有螃蟹，擊敗後會掉落未切割的輔助寶石等級4。石化海盜：掉落另一片撕碎的地圖碎片。用於完成選做任務忘卻寶物。大白鯊：棲息於鯊坑的巨型變異鯊魚，擊敗後掉落鯊魚鰭。將任務物品交給尼加卡努島上的凱馬拿，選擇以下獎勵岡姆的教誨或萊基亞塔的教誨，島上的盧哈奇會賣稀有物品建議逛一下。註：章節結束時，凱馬拿位於碼頭盡頭平台，與船隻相對位置。

name: Singing Caverns
guide:
Bosses: Diamora, Song of Death Quests: The Search , Whakapanu Island Points of Interest: Beckoning Clam (Optional: Rare Pearlescent Amulet )
The Singing Caverns is an underground passage, inhabited by amphibious prowlers, ghastly sirens and other nefarious sea creatures. Search the Cavern for Diamora, Song of Death , a physical and cold themed boss.
Diamora, Song of Death is a siren, avoid her petrifying song and gaze and consider equipping a Thawing Charm before the fight.
After defeating Diamora, Song of Death , speak to The Hooded One , return to town and sail to the next island.
Optionally, while exploring the Caverns you may encounter a Beckoning Clam. Interact with the Clam, defeat the ambush and interact with the Clam once more for a Humming Pearl . Return the Humming Pearl to Rog in town for a Rare Pearlescent Amulet .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 死亡之謠．黛莫拉任務: 大搜索 , 瓦卡帕努島興趣點: 呼喚之蚌 (可選: 稀有珠光項鍊 )
吟謠洞窟是一條地下通道，棲息著兩棲潛行者、駭人的海妖及其他邪惡海獸。探索洞穴尋找死亡之謠．黛莫拉——一名以物理攻擊為主、冰冷為主題的首領級怪物。
死亡之謠．黛莫拉是隻海妖，請避開她令人石化之歌與凝視，並考慮在戰鬥前裝備解凍護符。
擊敗死亡之謠．黛莫拉後，與黑衣幽魂對話，返回城鎮並航向下一座島嶼。返回城鎮后去找安潔继续惡意收購任務，即可传送到藏身處：海岸線，在清理掉地圖怪物后與安潔對話解鎖藏身處：海岸線。
探索洞穴時，你可能會遇到一隻呼喚之蚌。與蛤蜊互動、擊退伏擊後再次與其互動，即可獲得嗡鳴珍珠。將嗡鳴珍珠交還城鎮裡的羅格，便能換取稀有珠光項鍊。
馬提奇會在這邊出現，記得解救他。

name: Eye of Hinekora
content_zh_tw: 娜瓦莉憩地 ( 增加 5 %最大魔力 )
guide:
NPCs: Matiki , Navali Quests: Trial of the Ancestors Points of Interest: The Silent Hall
After previously freeing Matiki from Krutog, Lord of Kin in the Volcanic Warrens , the Karui Elder guides your ship to the Eye of Hinekora , a proving grounds to enter the Halls of the Dead .
Speak to Matiki and Navali , and peer into the Well of Passing, to seek approval from the Hinekora , to enter the proving grounds.
With Hinekora 's approval, your character is temporarily dead, but held in the Mother of Death's embrace, allowing you to pass into the spirit realm. Progress ahead and complete the following tests to enter the Halls of the Dead :
Kaom's Test of Mettle Maata's Test of Mettle Rakiata's Test of Mettle
After completing each test, near the end of the zone, search for The Silent Hall Secret, hidden behind a checkpoint. Explore the Silent Hall and pay your respects to receive a permanent +5% to Maximum Mana buff.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 馬提奇 , 娜瓦莉任務: 祖靈的試煉興趣點: 沉默之廳
先前在吟謠洞窟中將馬提奇解救後，卡魯長老引領你的船隻前往悉妮蔻拉之眼——這座進入亡者之殿的試煉場。
與馬提奇和娜瓦莉交談，凝視傳承之井，以獲取悉妮蔻拉的認可，方能進入試煉場。
獲得悉妮蔻拉認可後，你的角色將暫時死亡，但被死亡之母的懷抱所庇護，得以進入靈界。繼續前進並完成下列試煉，方能進入亡者之殿：
岡姆的實力考驗瑪塔的實力考驗萊基亞塔的實力考驗
完成每個區域的最終試煉後，請在區域末端尋找隱藏於檢查點後方的「沉默之廳」。探索沉默之廳並獻上敬意，即可獲得永久性「增加 5% 最大魔力」增益效果。

options: 30% increased Global Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield

+15% of Armour also applies to Elemental Damage
Gain Deflection Rating equal to 12% of Evasion Rating
12% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge

name: Halls of the Dead
content: Yama The White ( 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points )
Ancestral Tattoos ( +5 to Dexterity +5 % to Lightning Resistance +5 to Intelligence +5 % to Cold Resistance +5 to Strength +5 % to Fire Resistance )
content_zh_tw: 白之亞瑪 ( 2 武器套裝天賦點 )
先祖刺青 ( +5 點敏捷 +5 % 閃電抗性 +5 點智慧 +5 % 冰冷抗性 +5 點力量 +5 % 火焰抗性 )
guide:
NPCs: Navali Bosses: Yama The White (2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points) Quests: Trial of the Ancestors Points of Interest: Tasalio's Test , Ngamahu's Test , Tawhoa's Test
The Halls of the Dead is an ancestral proving ground, where the greatest warriors of the past battle endlessly. Explore the Halls for Yama The White , a physical and chaos themed boss.
While exploring, you may find additional Tests of Strength. Completing each test provides a Blank Tattoo which can be exchanged for a specific attribute or resist tattoo:
Tawhoa's Test : +5 Dexterity or +5% Lightning Resist Tasalio's Test : +5 Intelligence or +5% Cold Resist Ngamahu's Test : +5 Strength or +5% Fire Resist
Warning: consuming a Tattoo is a permanent choice that cannot be changed later on!
After completing each Test of Strength, progress to the end of the zone to find the entrance to the Trial of the Ancestors 's. However, once more you must prove your worth by defeating Yama The White .
After defeating Yama The White , loot the Silver Coin and enter the Trial of the Ancestors . Speak to Navali at the top of the trial for 2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points. Then return to town and sail to the next island.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 娜瓦莉頭目: 白之亞瑪 (2 武器天賦點數) 任務: 祖靈的試煉興趣點: 塔薩里奧的考驗 , 拿馬乎的考驗 , 塔赫亞的考驗
亡者之殿乃祖先的試煉場，昔日最偉大的戰士在此永無休止地交鋒。探索此廳以挑戰「白之亞瑪」——一位以物理與混沌為主題的首領。
在探索過程中，可能會發現額外的力量試煉。完成每項試煉將獲得空白刺青，可用於兌換特定屬性或抗性刺青：
塔赫亞的考驗 : +5 敏捷或 +5% 閃電抗性塔薩里奧的考驗 : +5 智慧 or +5% 冰冷抗性拿馬乎的考驗 : +5 力量或 +5% 火焰抗性
警告：消耗紋身是不可逆的永久性選擇，事後無法更改！
完成每項力量試煉後，前往區域盡頭尋找祖靈的試煉的入口。然而，必須再度擊敗白之亞瑪來證明自身價值。
擊敗閻魔後，拾取銀幣並進入祖靈的試煉。在試煉頂端與娜瓦莉對話，可獲悉妮蔻拉的刺青得2點武器天賦點數。隨後返回城鎮，乘船前往下一座島嶼。

name: Abandoned Prison
content: Goddess of Justice ( 30 % increased Life Recovery from Flasks 30 % increased Mana Recovery from Flasks )
content_zh_tw: 正義女神 ( 增加 30 % 藥劑的生命恢復增加 30 % 藥劑的魔力恢復 )
guide:
Quests: The Search , Abandoned Prison Points of Interest: The Chapel , The Armoury
The Abandoned Prison is is a time-worn penitentiary, haunted by spined necromancers, risen rattler's, eaten rats, eternal prisoners, eternal guards, and more. Search the zone for Solitary Confinement , to discover the darkness within.
While progressing you may find a Chapel Key , which can be used to enter The Chapel . Clear the enemies and interact with the Goddess of Justice for a choice between:
30% increased Life Recovery from Flasks 30% increased Mana Recovery from Flasks
If you would like to change your choice, you can always return to the Goddess and select a different option.
Additionally, you may find The Armoury Secret. A locked room full of gear, hidden in riot armaments. Simply interact with the nearby lever to enter and claim your potential rewards.
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 大搜索 , 廢棄監獄興趣點: 教堂 , 裝備庫
廢棄監獄是一座歷經歲月侵蝕的監獄，遊蕩著帶刺的死靈法師、復活的響尾蛇、被啃食的鼠群、永世囚徒與永世守衛等亡靈。探索此區域尋找單獨禁閉室，揭開深藏其中的黑暗。
在推進過程中，可能會發現一枚教堂鑰匙，可用於進入教堂。清除敵人後與正義女神互動，將面臨以下選擇：
藥劑的生命恢復增加 30% 藥劑的魔力恢復增加 30%
若想更改選擇，隨時可返回女神處重新挑選其他選項。
此外，您或許能發現「裝備庫秘境」——這間藏匿於暴動裝備中的密室，內有滿室裝備。只需操作附近的槓桿即可進入，並領取潛在獎勵。

name: Solitary Confinement
guide:
Bosses: The Prisoner Quests: The Search , Abandoned Prison
Solitary Confinement is built below the Abandoned Prison, and has been significantly water-damaged after centuries of neglect. So much so, that periodic waves of sea water submerge the prison floors, significantly lowering your movement speed.
Search for and defeat The Prisoner , a physical and cold themed boss, with a unique regenerative ability. At 50%, 25% and 10% HP, the Prisoner becomes staggered and immune to damage, after a short delay they begin to heal. Interact with a ballista on the edge of the arena and shoot the Prisoner with a piercing bolt to counter this regeneration. Note that after each ballista fired, the Prisoner gains new abilities.
After defeating The Prisoner , speak to The Hooded One and return to town.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 囚犯任務: 大搜索 , 廢棄監獄
單獨禁閉室建於廢棄監獄地底，歷經數世紀荒廢後遭受嚴重水損。海水定期湧入淹沒監獄地板，大幅降低你的移動速度。
搜尋並擊敗囚犯——一名具備物理與冰霜屬性主題的頭目，擁有獨特的再生能力。當囚徒生命值降至50%、25%及10%時，將陷入暈眩狀態且免疫傷害，短暫延遲後開始自我修復。此時需操作競技場邊緣的弩炮，以穿透性弩箭射擊囚徒來中斷其再生。需注意每次弩炮發射後，囚徒將獲得新能力。
擊敗囚犯後，與黑衣幽魂對話並返回船上。

name: Shrike Island
guide:
Bosses: Scourge of the Skies Quests: The Search , Shrike Island , Forgotten Bounty (Optional) Points of Interest: Corpse Nest
Shrike Island is a vicious rite of passage for Karui; that has become deadlier with the growing corruption. Vile Vultures, ravenous shrikes, scavenged skeletons and other hungry creatures await you. Search the island for the Scourge of the Skies , a physical themed boss.
Defeat the Scourge of the Skies , speak to The Hooded One , and speak to Makoru . Then set sail to Arastas .
While scavenging the island, you may find the Corpse Nest Secret. Interact with the Corpse Nest for the fourth and final Torn Map Piece . To review, Torn Map Piece s are used to complete the optional Forgotten Bounty quest and drop from the following islands:
Isle of Kin Kedge Bay Whakapanu Island Shrike Island
Returning all four Torn Map Piece s to Makoru unlocks Plunder's Point . An optional area that introduces the Expedition mechanic. Summon Dannig , place the explosives around potentially rewarding locations, explode the explosives and clear the monsters for experience and loot.
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 天之禍殃任務: 大搜索 , 伯勞鳥之島 , 忘卻寶物 (可選) 興趣點: Corpse Nest
伯勞鳥之島是卡魯部族殘酷的成年儀式，隨著腐敗日益加劇，這場試煉變得更加致命。邪惡禿鷲、貪婪鵟鳥、啃食骸骨的亡魂與其他飢餓生物正等待著你。在島上搜尋實體主題首領——天之禍殃。
擊敗天之禍殃，與黑衣幽魂交談，再與瑪寇魯對話。隨後啟航前往阿拉塔斯。
在島上搜刮時，你可能會發現「屍骸巢穴」的祕密。與屍骸巢穴互動即可獲得第四塊也是最後一塊的撕碎的地圖碎片。回顧一下，撕碎的地圖碎片用於完成可選任務「忘卻寶物」，可從以下島嶼掉落：金氏島，凱吉灣，瓦卡帕努島，伯勞鳥之島
將四片撕碎的地圖碎片全數歸還給瑪寇魯，即可解鎖新島嶼掠奪者之角。此為選修區域，將引導玩家體驗死境探險遠征機制,進入島嶼后召喚丹尼格，於潛在豐厚報酬地點佈設一連串的炸藥，盡可能多的引爆寶箱後清除怪物以獲取經驗值與戰利品。
符文探求者 : 從掠奪者之角進入廢棄哨站，拿取桌上的符鍛知識

name: Arastas
guide:
NPCs: Missionary Lorandis Bosses: Torvian, Hand of the Saviour Quests: The Search Points of Interest: Golden Bells
Arastas is the point of operations for the Twilight Order, a peaceful enclave also in search of the Weapon. Speak to Missionary Lorandis for more information.
Surprise! You've been betrayed once more! Break the barrier, survive the ambush and search for The Excavation .
While searching for The Excavation site, near the end of the zone you can find two Golden Bells:
The Morning Bell is located in the Town Square and provides 3 Regal Orb s. The Evening Bell is located at the Cliffside and provides 3 Exalted Orb s.
At the end of the zone you encounter Torvian, Hand of the Saviour , a physical and fire themed boss. Torvian is an incredibly challenging fight that can be made easier with an understanding of his Rock Toss ability. Surrounding the arena are three casters that periodically empower Torvian, most notably with damage reduction. When Torvian slams both axes into the ground, he emerges with a Rock that he tosses at the player. Position near a casters platform and dodge the Rock after it's thrown to interrupt the empowerment.
guide_zh_tw:
NPCs: 傳道士羅蘭迪斯頭目: 救贖者之手．托維安任務: 大搜索興趣點: 黃金之鐘
阿拉塔斯是暮光教團的行動據點，這個和平的聚居地同樣在追尋那件武器。欲知詳情，請與傳道士羅蘭迪斯交談。
驚喜！你再次遭到背叛！突破防線，躲過埋伏，尋找挖掘。
在探索挖掘遺址時，區域末端可發現兩座黃金之鐘：
晨鐘位於城鎮廣場，提供3枚富豪石。晚鐘位於懸崖邊緣，可提供3枚崇高石。
區域盡頭將遭遇救贖者之手．托維安，此為物理與火焰屬性主題的首領戰。托維安的戰鬥極具挑戰性，若能掌握其「岩石投擲」技能便能降低難度。競技場周邊設有三座法師平台，會定期強化托維安，最關鍵的是賦予其傷害減免效果。當托維安將雙斧猛擊地面時，他將從岩石中現身並向玩家投擲巨石。請貼近法師平台站位，在巨石投擲後立即閃避以中斷強化效果。

name: The Excavation
guide:
Bosses: Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia Quests: The Search
The Excavation Site is swarming with the most zealous members of the Twilight Order and is host to Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia a physical, fire and lightning themed boss.
Search for and defeat Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia . Timely dodge rolls and specific understanding of his Earthen Maze mechanics are key.
After defeating Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia , follow Tavakai and Makoru to the Weapon. Upon arrival, The Hooded One joins you and attempts to reforge the Weapon.
Unsurprisingly, you've been betrayed again! This time by Tavakai who wishes to use the Weapon to save his people. Can you trust anyone at this point?
Speak to The Hooded One , return to town, speak to The Hooded One once more, and then to Rhodri to set sail to Ngakanu .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 烏托邦的第一使者．本篤特斯任務: 大搜索
挖掘聚集了暮光教團最狂熱的成員，並駐守著以實體、火焰與閃電為主題的首領——烏托邦的第一使者．本篤特斯。
搜尋並擊敗烏托邦的第一使者．本篤特斯。關鍵在於及時閃避攻擊，並精準掌握其「大地迷宮」機制。
擊敗烏托邦的第一使者．本篤特斯後，跟隨塔瓦凱與瑪寇魯前往武器所在地。抵達時，黑衣幽魂將加入隊伍並嘗試重鑄武器。
不出所料，你再次遭人背叛！這次是塔瓦凱，他企圖利用武器拯救族人。此刻你還能信任誰？
與黑衣幽魂對話後返回城鎮，再次與黑衣幽魂交談，接著找羅德里啟航前往尼加卡努。

name: Ngakanu
guide:
Quests: The Search
Ngakanu is home to the Tukohama Tribe, however, the tribe members are enraged with blood-fevered fury, attacking anyone and everyone on site. Battle your way through the village, in search of the Heart of the Tribe .
guide_zh_tw:
任務: 大搜索
尼加卡努是圖克哈瑪部落的所在地，然而部落成員正陷入嗜血狂怒，對現場所有人展開無差別攻擊。請奮勇闖過村莊，尋找部族之心。

name: Heart of the Tribe
guide:
Bosses: Tavakai, the Chieftain Quests: The Search Points of Interest: Meeting House
The Heart of the Tribe embodies the same blood-fevered rage found in Ngakanu. Search the area for Tavakai, the Chieftain , the boss of Act 4.
While exploring the area, you may find the Meeting House Secret, a room outlined with chests full of loot. Consider making any final upgrades at this point before confronting Tavakai, the Chieftain .
Tavakai, the Chieftain is a multi-phase, physical, fire, cold and lightning themed boss. Precise dodge rolls, positioning and life recovery are key to defeating Tavakai, the Chieftain .
After defeating Tavakai, the Chieftain , witness The Hooded One curing both Tavakai and Makoru . Then speak to Tavakai , return to Kingsmarch , and speak to The Hooded One .
guide_zh_tw:
頭目: 酋長．塔瓦凱任務: 大搜索興趣點: 聚會所
部族之心蘊含著與尼加卡努相同的嗜血狂怒。搜尋此區域尋找頭目——酋長．塔瓦凱。
探索期間，你可能發現「聚會所祕密」——這處被寶箱環繞的房間藏有豐厚戰利品。建議在此處完成最終裝備升級，再迎戰酋長．塔瓦凱。
酋長．塔瓦凱是位具備多階段戰鬥模式、以物理、火焰、寒冰與閃電為主題的首領。精準的閃避翻滾、站位控制與生命恢復能力，是擊敗酋長．塔瓦凱的關鍵。
擊敗酋長．塔瓦凱後，見證黑衣幽魂治癒塔瓦凱與瑪寇魯。隨後與塔瓦凱對話，返回金司馬區，再與黑衣幽魂交談。

name: Qimah
